utility.name: Python machine learning environment
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: A Python 3 virtual environment in /opt/python_ml_env with numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow (CPU), Flask and JupyterLab, activated in every interactive bash shell, plus the Keras MNIST archive for offline use. Provides the python_ml_env::notebook_repo define, which other modules use to install a notebook repository at a fixed commit into each account's home directory.
